_instructions.authors: Add authors in publication order. Each item needs name, affiliation_ids, corresponding (true/false), and email only for the corresponding author.
_instructions.affiliations: Map string IDs such as 1, 2 to full department/institution/city/region/country text.
_instructions.present_addresses: Use [] if none. Otherwise add complete present-address strings.
_instructions.funding_acknowledgments: Enter confirmed funding/grant text, or an explicit no-external-funding statement if true.
_instructions.author_contributions: Enter the all-author-approved CRediT-style contribution statement.
_instructions.conflict_of_interest: Enter the all-author-confirmed statement; do not assume none.
_instructions.ai_tool_inventory_confirmed: Set true only after confirming the complete AI-tool inventory with all authors.
_instructions.additional_ai_tools: Use [] only after inventory confirmation if no AI tools beyond OpenAI ChatGPT were used.
_instructions.dual_publication_statement: Enter the all-author-confirmed overlap/dual-publication statement for ScholarOne.
_instructions.review_code_url: Public GitHub is currently configured for peer review.
_instructions.permanent_archive_doi: Optional at initial submission; add the permanent DOI after acceptance.
_instructions.privacy: Copy this template to an untracked local file before filling it. Do not commit completed author/contact metadata to the public repository unless all authors explicitly want it public.
